✦ System Requirements ✦

Can You Run It?

⚡ Minimum Requirements
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
    Build 1903 or higher
  • CPU: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
    Quad-core, 2.5 GHz+
  • RAM: 4 GB System RAM
    2 GB allocated to Minecraft
  • GPU: Intel UHD / GTX 750
    OpenGL 4.5 support required
  • Storage: 4 GB free space
    SSD recommended
  • Java: Java 21 (auto-installed)
    Bundled with the launcher
  • Internet: 5 Mbps broadband
    Stable connection required
🚀 Recommended Requirements
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
    For best performance
  • CPU: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
    6-core, 3.5 GHz+
  • RAM: 8–16 GB System RAM
    4–6 GB allocated to Minecraft
  • GPU: GTX 1060 / RX 580 or better
    For shaders & high render distance
  • Storage: 8 GB free space on SSD
    Faster world loading
  • Java: Java 21 (bundled)
    No manual install needed
  • Internet: 25 Mbps+ broadband
    Low ping = smooth gameplay
